decision_time: T0 — after Agent 1 recognition and before ordered investigation results return

guideline.name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign 2026
guideline.citation: Prescott HC, et al. Crit Care Med 2026;54:725-812

design_notes: Agent 2 performs diagnostic workup planning at T0.
Agent 2 uses a sequential accumulation graph rather than a mutually exclusive branching classification graph.
All four workup nodes are evaluated for every patient unless the system abstains because of repeated validation failure.
The model may only return one of the allowed_answers at each node.
Each node evaluates exactly one closed-set workup category.
Node decisions accumulate into one final Agent 2 workup plan.
The model does not invent workup categories outside the closed Agent 2 item set.
Only information available at T0 may be used.
Laboratory, microbiology, imaging, or other investigation results that become available after T0 must not be exposed to Agent 2.
Guideline scopes are frozen and injected verbatim at runtime.
The primary Agent 2 safety risk is over-ordering.

W1.title: Blood cultures
W1.question: Based only on information available at T0 and the current investigation status, should blood cultures be addressed as part of the sepsis diagnostic workup?

stmt_007: collect blood cultures as soon as possible

rules: Use only information available at T0.
Return recommend when blood cultures are guideline-supported and are not already documented as addressed.
Return already_addressed when blood cultures are already ordered or collected before or at T0.
Do not infer that cultures were not performed solely because no record is present.
If status cannot be determined from available information, return indeterminate.
Do not recommend delaying antimicrobial treatment in order to obtain blood cultures.
The blood-culture and antimicrobial sequencing relationship is evaluated separately using deterministic timing logic.

W2.title: Blood lactate
W2.question: Based only on information available at T0 and the current investigation status, should blood lactate be addressed as part of the sepsis diagnostic workup?
rules: Use only information available at T0.
Return recommend when initial blood lactate measurement is guideline-supported and is not already addressed.
Return already_addressed when blood lactate is already ordered or collected before or at T0.
Do not use a lactate result that becomes available after T0.
Do not make serial lactate recommendations in this node.
Serial lactate measurement and perfusion-guided resuscitation belong to later reassessment or treatment logic.
If investigation status cannot be determined, return indeterminate.

W3.title: Source-directed workup
W3.question: Based only on information available at T0, is additional source-directed imaging or sampling needed to evaluate for a specific anatomical diagnosis or source of infection that may require emergent source control?
W3.scope_source: Agent 2 design-aligned SSC 2026 scope; graph-derived scope manually verified

stmt_023: rapid evaluation for a specific anatomical diagnosis or infection source requiring emergent source control

rules: Use only information available at T0.
This node decides whether source-directed diagnostic evaluation should be addressed, not which source-control procedure should be performed.
Do not invent a specific imaging modality, anatomical study, or microbiological sampling procedure that is not directly supported by an approved source.
Return recommend when the presentation indicates a need for further source-directed diagnostic evaluation.
Return already_addressed when appropriate source-directed imaging or sampling is already ordered or performed before or at T0.
Return not_indicated only when the available T0 information does not support additional source-directed workup.
If the need for further source-directed workup cannot be determined, return indeterminate.

W4.title: Alternative-diagnosis workup
W4.question: Based only on information available at T0, is additional diagnostic evaluation needed for an important noninfectious alternative to sepsis?
W4.scope_source: Agent 2 design-aligned SSC 2026 scope; graph-derived scope manually verified

stmt_005: sepsis should not be ruled in or ruled out using a single biomarker or diagnostic test
stmt_019: rapid assessment of infectious versus noninfectious causes in possible sepsis without shock

rules: Use only information available at T0.
This node determines whether additional evaluation of a clinically important noninfectious alternative is needed.
Do not diagnose a specific mimic unless supported by the available patient evidence.
Do not invent disease-specific testing recommendations that are not supported by an approved guideline source.
A single biomarker or diagnostic test must not be treated as sufficient to rule sepsis in or out.
Return recommend when a clinically meaningful noninfectious alternative remains sufficiently plausible to warrant additional evaluation.
Return already_addressed when relevant alternative-diagnosis evaluation is already ordered or performed before or at T0.
Return not_indicated when the available T0 information does not support additional alternative-diagnosis evaluation.
If the need for additional evaluation cannot be determined, return indeterminate.

WORKUP_COMPLETE.description: All four Agent 2 workup categories have been evaluated. The final workup plan is assembled from the accumulated W1-W4 decisions.

ABSTAIN.description: Agent 2 could not produce a valid grounded response after the permitted repair attempt.

node_output_schema.answer: one value from the current node allowed_answers

supporting_evidence.statement_id: statement id from the current node scope
supporting_evidence.quote: verbatim quote from the injected guideline statement
supporting_evidence.implication: brief explanation connecting the patient finding and guideline to the answer

opposing_evidence.statement_id: statement id from the current node scope or null when no approved source is available
opposing_evidence.quote: verbatim guideline quote when statement_id is not null
opposing_evidence.implication: brief explanation of why this argues against the selected answer

missing_information: clinically relevant information unavailable at T0

basis: statement ids cited by the corresponding node
recommendations.reason: patient-specific reason derived from the validated node response

missing_information: reason the workup decision could not be resolved

V1.name: closed_answer_validation
V1.description: The answer returned for each node must be one of that node's allowed_answers.

V2.name: citation_scope_validation
V2.description: Every cited guideline statement id must belong to the current node's frozen scope.

V3.name: verbatim_quote_validation
V3.description: Every quoted guideline passage must appear verbatim in the guideline text injected for the current node.

t0_leakage.description: Strip or ignore laboratory, microbiology, imaging, treatment, or investigation results whose availability timestamp is after T0.

blood_culture_antimicrobial_sequence.description: When structured timestamps are available, determine whether blood cultures were collected before antimicrobial administration. The model does not control this sequencing check.

duplicate_ordering.description: An item classified as already_addressed must not also appear in the final recommendations list.

closed_item_set.description: The final workup plan may contain only the four Agent 2 workup categories defined in allowed_items.

behavior.recommend: Add the node item to final recommendations using the priority defined in decision_mapping.
behavior.already_addressed: Add the node item to final already_addressed.
behavior.not_indicated: Add the node item to final not_indicated.
behavior.indeterminate: Add the node item to final indeterminate together with the node missing_information.

accumulation.completion_condition: W1, W2, W3, and W4 have each produced a valid response.
